semiconductor_relevance: Medium — LEG Thüringen supports semiconductor-related investments and development but does not directly supply semiconductor products or services.
summary: LEG Thüringen acts as a one-stop shop agency facilitating investments in the microelectronics and optics sectors within Thüringen, Germany. They provide a range of services including access to R&D infrastructure, support for urban and regional development, and assistance with recruitment and financing for companies looking to invest in semiconductor-related projects.

regional_presence.Germany: LEG Thüringen promotes the Thüringen region as a hub for microelectronics and optics, leveraging existing supplier structures and R&D capabilities.
